name: Dragonfly Dev
author: TH3N3WN00B@users.noreply.github.com
description: Experimental: the daily development build of Dragonfly, built from its main branch. Dragonfly is an in-memory data store fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs. Use the Dragonfly egg for anything you depend on.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Dragonfly Development Build Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Import data from a Redis server: Dragonfly loads dump.rdb on start while it has no snapshot of its own.
if [ -f dump.rdb ] && [ ! -f dump-summary.dfs ]; then
    SRC_VER=$(head -c 128 dump.rdb | tr -c ' -~' ' ' | sed -n 's/.*redis-ver *\([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p')
    SRC_VER=${SRC_VER:-unknown}
    if ! ls -d backups/*-redis-"${SRC_VER}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        BACKUP="backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-redis-${SRC_VER}"
        mkdir -p "${BACKUP}"
        cp -p dump.rdb "${BACKUP}/"
        echo -e "Backed up the data written by Redis ${SRC_VER} to ${BACKUP}. Dragonfly imports it on the next start."
    fi
fi

# The development builds are only published as container images, so the binary is taken from the image layers.
ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] && echo "amd64" || echo "arm64")
REPO="dragonflydb/dragonfly-dev"
REGISTRY="https://ghcr.io/v2/${REPO}"
TAG="${DF_DEV_TAG:-ubuntu}"

echo -e "Looking up ghcr.io/${REPO}:${TAG} (linux/${ARCH})"
TOKEN=$(curl -fsSL "https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository:${REPO}:pull" | jq -r '.token // empty')
MANIFEST=$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
    -H "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json, application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json, application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json, application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json" \
    "${REGISTRY}/manifests/${TAG}")
DIGEST=$(jq -r --arg arch "${ARCH}" '.manifests[]? | select(.platform.os == "linux" and .platform.architecture == $arch) | .digest' <<< "${MANIFEST}")
if [ -n "${DIGEST}" ]; then
    MANIFEST=$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
        -H "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json, application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json" \
        "${REGISTRY}/manifests/${DIGEST}")
fi
LAYERS=$(jq -r '.layers | reverse | .[].digest' <<< "${MANIFEST}" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "${LAYERS}" ]; then
    echo -e "Could not find the linux/${ARCH} image of ghcr.io/${REPO}:${TAG}"
    exit 1
fi
REVISION=$(curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" "${REGISTRY}/blobs/$(jq -r '.config.digest' <<< "${MANIFEST}")" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.revision"] // empty' 2>/dev/null)

# The binary is copied into the image last, so start with the last layer. Layers are streamed straight
# into tar on the server disk, because /tmp in the install container is a small tmpfs.
WORK_DIR=/mnt/server/.dragonfly-dev-install
rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}"
for LAYER in ${LAYERS}; do
    echo -e "Downloading layer ${LAYER}"
    curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" "${REGISTRY}/blobs/${LAYER}" | tar -xzf - -C "${WORK_DIR}" usr/local/bin/dragonfly 2>/dev/null
    if [ "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -ne 0 ]; then
        rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"
        echo -e "Failed to download ${LAYER}"
        exit 1
    fi
    if [ -f "${WORK_DIR}/usr/local/bin/dragonfly" ]; then
        break
    fi
done

if [ ! -f "${WORK_DIR}/usr/local/bin/dragonfly" ]; then
    rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"
    echo -e "The image ghcr.io/${REPO}:${TAG} does not contain /usr/local/bin/dragonfly"
    exit 1
fi

mv -f "${WORK_DIR}/usr/local/bin/dragonfly" dragonfly
chmod +x dragonfly
rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"

# The development binary keeps its debug symbols. Strip them to save disk space; the binary works either way.
SIZE_BEFORE=$(du -m dragonfly | cut -f1)
if ! command -v strip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends binutils >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
if command -v strip >/dev/null 2>&1 && strip --strip-debug dragonfly; then
    echo -e "Removed the debug symbols from the binary (${SIZE_BEFORE} MB -> $(du -m dragonfly | cut -f1) MB)."
else
    echo -e "Could not remove the debug symbols, keeping the full binary (${SIZE_BEFORE} MB)."
fi

echo -e "Install complete. Dragonfly development build ${TAG} ${REVISION:+(commit ${REVISION:0:7}) }installed for ${ARCH}."

variables.name: Dragonfly Password
variables.description: The password Dragonfly should use to secure the server.

variables.name: Development Build
variables.description: The dragonfly-dev image tag to install: ubuntu for the newest daily build, or ubuntu-<commit> (for example ubuntu-f7fe6c4) to pin one build. Reinstall the server to update or apply a change.

variables.name: Threads
variables.description: Number of Dragonfly threads. Each thread needs at least 256 MB of memory. 0 uses every CPU core of the host.

variables.name: Snapshot Schedule
variables.description: Cron expression for periodic snapshots to disk, for example */5 * * * * for every 5 minutes. Leave empty to only save on shutdown.
